bodyTexelRework: All occupied normal-texture texels receive a non-uniform cool value treatment keyed to original luminance plus low-amplitude coordinate variation. Eight previously transparent palette slots at x=80..87,y=63 carry the V46 cosmetic material colors. Alpha is preserved for every official texel.
paletteIntent: Keep Lucario recognizable while shifting the normal surface toward a colder Aura Sentinel hierarchy: deep navy shadows, stronger blue midtones and restrained pale highlights. Coordinate variation prevents a single uniform multiply or hue rotation.
materialIntent: Biological dark regions retain lower values; light planes gain cooler highlights; midtones separate into multiple blue values. The V46 wrap, sash and halo use an independent pale-blue/navy ramp so the costume separates from the body at gameplay scale.
note: This is a technically valid full-surface derived normal texture for V46 review. It is not owner-approved and does not claim final paint quality. Shiny remains independently blocked from promotion until a derived shiny pass receives the same provenance treatment.
